content: Wurseththa Zore
Ta inttena dosizaytoo! Ta inttena laamotizaytoo! Taas ufayssinne ooso zawude gidida ta ishatoo! Godaan minni eqqite.
Intte qofay Godaan issino gidana mala Ewodiyanne Sinxekey ba garsan siiqettana mala ta istta woossays.

Ero! Nenoo! Tanara issife ammanettida oosanchchazoo! Mishiraachcho qaalaa yootos tanaranne Qalamenxoosara qasseka istta sunththay de7o maxaafan xaafettida hankko tanara ooso laggetara issife waayettida maccassata ne maaddana mala ta nena woossays.
Ay wodekka Godaan ufayettite; qasseka ta inttena ufayettite gays.
Intte kiyateththi as ubbaa achchan eretto; Goday yaana matides.
Haniza yo7on ubbaan galatan, woosaninne gaannateththan Xoossa sinth shiiqite attiin ay miishshankka hirgofte.
Asa qofappe bollara diza Xoossa saroteththi intte wozinanne intte qofaa wursi Yesus Kirstoosan naagees.

Wurseththa bolla ta ishatoo! Tumu gidida yo7o ubbaa, bonchcho gidida yo7o ubbaa, adda gidida yo7o ubbaa, geeshshi gidida yo7o ubbaa, dosettida miish ubbaa, lo7o gidida yo7o ubbaa, lo7eteth gidiinkka galatakka haytantta misatizaaz ubbaa qopite.
Intte taappe tamaardayssa woykko ekkidayssanne siyidayssa woykko be7idayssa ay gidikkoka ubbaa ooththite; Goday inttenara gidana.
Phawuloosi Maaddidaytas Shiishshida Galata

Daro wodeppe guye ooraththa qofara intte ta gishshas qofo oykkideta; hessika Godaa baggara tana keehi ufayssees; tumukka intte taas qofo aggibeekketashin intte qoppida mala ooththanaas inttes hano ixxides.
Tani hessa gizay tana metida gishshas gidenna; gaasoykka ta ay hankkoka, «Dizayssi taas gidana» guus tamaaradis.
Pacekka ta erays; demmadakka erays; gafadakka, kalladakka erays; diinka dhayiinkka erays; ay gidikkoka taas dizay gidana guussa xuura ta lo7eththa erays.
Taas wolqqa immiza Kirstoosan tani ubba miish ooththanaas dandayays.
Gidikkoka intte tana ta waayen maaddida gishshas lo7o ooththideta.

Intte Piliphisiyoose asati hessafe bollara intte erizay koyro Mishiraachcho qaalaa intte ekkida wode tani Maqidooniyappe dendashe inttefe attiin gede immidikka haa ekkidikka maadettidinne maaddidi giza Woosa Keeththi taas deenna.
Haray attoshin ta kase Tasolonqen diza wodekka tani metotiin intte zaari zaari taas maado yeddideta.
Ta hessa gizay immida gishshas inttes anjjoy darana mala gaada attiin ta inttefe maado ekkanaas amottada gidenna.

Taas koshshizayssanne tana koshshizayssafekka bollara ekkadis; intte taas yeddida maado miishshaa Afrodixo kusheppe ekkiin ta pacey kumides; hayssi daroppe Xoossa achchan ekettida daro lo7o sawiza yarsho mala.
Xoossi ba dureteththaa gina inttes koshshizayssa Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa baggara kunththana.
Nu Aawassinne nu Xoossaas mernaappe mernaas bonchchoy gido. Amiin.
Wurseththa Saroka
Ammaniza asa ubbaa Yesus Kirstoosa sunththan saro giite; tanara diza ishati wurikka inttena saro geettes.
Ammanizayti wuri harappeka Qeesaareso asaappe ammanizayti wurikka inttena saro geettes.
Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa aadho kiyateththi inttenara gido. Amiin.
